mapper.select: SELECT f.folder_id, f.folder_name, f.parent_id, f.folder_level, f.folder_path, f.folder_code, f.sort_order, f.description, f.icon, f.status, f.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_doc d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.folder_id IN ( SELECT folder_id FROM kb_folder WHERE del_flag = '0' AND (folder_id = f.folder_id OR folder_path LIKE CONCAT(f.folder_path, '/', f.folder_id, '%')) )) as doc_count FROM kb_folder f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.folder_id = #{folderId}

SELECT f.folder_id, f.folder_name, f.parent_id, f.folder_level, f.folder_path, f.folder_code, f.sort_order, f.description, f.icon, f.status, f.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_doc d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.folder_id = f.folder_id) as doc_count FROM kb_folder f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.sort_order ASC

SELECT f.folder_id, f.folder_name, f.parent_id, f.folder_level, f.folder_path, f.folder_code, f.sort_order, f.description, f.icon, f.status, f.create_time FROM kb_folder f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.parent_id = #{parentId} AND f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.sort_order ASC
